import os
from backend.services.db import DB_PATH
import subprocess

def set_perms():
    if os.name == 'nt':
        subprocess.run(['icacls', str(DB_PATH), '/inheritance:r', '/grant:r', f"{os.environ.get('USERNAME','%USERNAME%')}:F"], check=True)
        print(f"Set permissions for {DB_PATH} on Windows.")
    else:
        os.chmod(DB_PATH, 0o600)
        print(f"Set permissions for {DB_PATH} on POSIX.")
